from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    differences = {}
    for color in colors:
        above = sum(v == color for row in grid[:divider] for v in row)
        below = sum(v == color for row in grid[divider + 1:] for v in row)
        differences[color] = abs(above - below)
    winner = max(colors, key=lambda color: differences[color])
    return [[winner, winner], [winner, winner]]
'''
path=programs/'task-f58be651.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(source, globals())
